name: Light Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, plunge into cold water, drain, and blend to a smooth purée.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes. Add the tomato and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach purée and ¼ cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the silken tofu and garam masala.
Add the paneer and simmer for 3 minutes. Season with salt.
note: Blanching and cooling the spinach keeps it bright green. Uses no butter or cream.
